messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand your concern, but turning off airplane mode is safe and won't affect your photos or any data. Airplane mode simply blocks all wireless signals temporarily. Let's turn it off first.

On your phone, please run:

**toggle_airplane_mode**

This will turn airplane mode OFF. After you do that, wait a few seconds, then check your status bar again by running:

**check_status_bar**

Let me know what it shows now (do you see signal bars, 5G/LTE, etc., and is the airplane icon gone?).

I turned airplane mode off. After that, my phone's status bar now shows signal bars, a "2G" network indicator, mobile data enabled, and battery at 80%. The airplane icon is gone. What should we do next?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
